tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Primary brand color: primary CTAs, navigation, active states, single-series charts. White text on it (on-sky) is 3.7:1, so button labels are 20px/600 (large text).

tokens.name: sky-bright
tokens.usage: Hover accents and soft highlights; also the 1px bottom edge on a hovered primary button. Never text.

tokens.name: sky-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons, focused-input borders, focus ring, and sky-family text on sky-soft (5.9:1) or white (6.7:1).

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the active nav item, selected lesson, subject tags, help bubbles, progress-bar track.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Achievements ONLY: star badges, streak flame, rank #1, rewards. Never for primary actions, warnings or payments. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: sun-bright
tokens.usage: Achievement glow when a badge is first earned (shadow-glow).

tokens.name: sun-deep
tokens.usage: Hover state on sun elements; the streak flame stroke.

tokens.name: sun-soft
tokens.usage: Streak-counter pill and the “Easy” difficulty tag, with ink text. Added: the source names sun-soft for tags without a value.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Progress fill and correct-answer borders. Not text (2.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Correct-answer tile fill, Paid / Present / Active status pills, “What you got right” box.

tokens.name: leaf-deep
tokens.usage: Strong correct indicator: checkmark badges, checked attendance box, “Keep going!” button fill.

tokens.name: leaf-ink
tokens.usage: Added for legibility: leaf-family text on leaf-soft (4.8:1).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Gentle error: incorrect-answer border (dashed), error input border. Never harsh red, never text.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: “Let’s try again” feedback fill, Overdue / Absent / Declined pills, “review next time” box.

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Added for legibility: coral-family text on coral-soft (5.4:1) and inline error messages.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: bonus content, trial-lesson stage, English timetable slots; second chart series (dashed).

tokens.name: berry-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for trial-stage pills and berry avatars. Added: the source names berry-soft for Hard tags without a value.

tokens.name: berry-ink
tokens.usage: Added for legibility: berry-family text on berry-soft (6.3:1).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards at rest in dense areas, sidebar, inputs, answer tiles.

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Modals and focused content, cards on the page.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells, drop zones, neutral “Due” pills, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface (17.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and instructions on background, surface and surface-sunken (7.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Source value kept: 2.6:1 on white, below 4.5:1. Use for decorative marks and placeholders only; metadata text uses ink-muted instead.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled controls, off stars, switch track when off.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Card edges, dividers, table rules, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: outline-strong
tokens.usage: Drop-zone dashed border, unchecked checkbox border (3:1 is not met on white: 2.6:1, pair it with the 32px box shape).

tokens.name: on-sky
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sky, sky-deep and leaf-deep fills.
